turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Excuse me, do you have a minute? I did not understand the part about the deadline.

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: Tabbas. Takarda ta ƙare Juma'a da tsakar dare, but you can ask for an extension idan kana buƙata.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: So can I submit it on Monday?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: Sai dai in ka aika mini email kafin Juma'a and ask for an extension. Ka bayyana dalilin, kuma galibi ina cewa eh.
